reason: The cited evidence (E1) only confirms that oxygen contamination at ~1 wt% occurs and causes microstructural inhomogeneities; it provides no support for the claims that these defects dominate electron scattering, that explicit supercell/Monte Carlo simulation is feasible for this system, or that such simulations would yield conductivity within 20% of experiment.
premises: Oxygen contamination in HfNbTaTiZr reaches ~1 wt% and causes defect clusters/second phases
These oxygen-induced defects dominate electron scattering
Explicit simulation of such defects via supercells with Monte Carlo sampling is feasible
This approach will capture scattering absent in perfect-crystal models
The resulting conductivity predictions will fall within 20% of experiment
